comments.body:
I reviewed the full solution and verified it rigorously.

Framework: refines unique-fixed-point hypotheses into Picard-operator property in an ordered metric space with d-closed order, plus monotonicity (H4) of dominated operator A and pointwise dominance (H3) A<=B.

Proof structure verified: Lemma 1 (x<=A(x) => x<=x*_A via monotone induction + Picard limit + closed order); Lemma 2 (x*_A<=x*_B via induction A^n<=B^n using only monotonicity of A and dominance, then Picard limit); Theorem by transitivity.

Numerical verification: 231 valid finite-poset configs (monotone Picard A, dominating Picard B) gave 0 counterexamples; both sharpness examples (dropping H3, dropping H4) confirmed to break the conclusion.

Proof is complete, rigorous, hypotheses sharp. No gap remains. Resolving.
